title: Exasol for VS Code
tagline: SQL editing and schema browsing inside VS Code.
role: The Exasol VS Code extension, installed into VS Code itself. A copy you already installed from the VS Code Marketplace is respected and never touched.
installed_by: Only through exakit marketplace, and only on a machine that has VS Code or a fork the kit can drive: VS Code Insiders, Cursor, VSCodium or Windsurf. The kit finds them by their own CLI (code, code-insiders, cursor, windsurf, codium) and installs the same .vsix into whichever it finds first, VS Code proper first.

quickstart.note: Space selects Exasol for VS Code, Enter installs it.
Then connect it with the details from exakit info.

commands.summary: The connection details to type into the extension.

troubleshooting.remedy: No VS Code-compatible editor was found on this machine, so the kit does not offer it. The kit looks for the code, code-insiders, cursor, windsurf and codium commands on PATH and for the usual install locations of VS Code, VS Code Insiders, Cursor, Windsurf and VSCodium. If your editor is installed but its CLI is not on PATH, add it (in VS Code: the 'Shell Command: Install code command in PATH' command) and re-run exakit marketplace.
The kit recognises it and will not manage or re-offer it.
